test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 25 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Pipe A and B together can fill a tank in 16 minutes. Pipe B and C together can fill the same tank in 20 minutes. Pipe C and A together can fill the same tank in 24 minutes. Firstly pipe C is opened. After 'L' minutes, pipes A and B both are also opened. Remaining tank got filled in 4 minutes. What is the value of L?
solution:
**Given:**

A + B = 16 minutes

B + C = 20 minutes

C + A = 24 minutes

Remaining work filled in 4 minutes by A + B + C

**Formula Used:**

Work rate = 1 ÷ Time

Total work = Sum of individual rates

**Calculation:**

⇒ A + B = 1 ÷ 16

⇒ B + C = 1 ÷ 20

⇒ C + A = 1 ÷ 24

⇒ Adding all: 2(A + B + C) = 1 ÷ 16 + 1 ÷ 20 + 1 ÷ 24

⇒ LCM = 240

⇒ 1 ÷ 16 = 15 ÷ 240, 1 ÷ 20 = 12 ÷ 240, 1 ÷ 24 = 10 ÷ 240

⇒ 2(A + B + C) = 37 ÷ 240

⇒ A + B + C = 37 ÷ 480

⇒ Work done in last 4 min = 4 × (37 ÷ 480)

⇒ = 148 ÷ 480 = 37 ÷ 120

⇒ Remaining work after C alone = 1 − 37 ÷ 120

⇒ = 83 ÷ 120

⇒ C = (B + C) − B

⇒ First find B

⇒ (A + B + C) − (A + B) = C

⇒ C = 37 ÷ 480 − 1 ÷ 16

⇒ 1 ÷ 16 = 30 ÷ 480

⇒ C = 7 ÷ 480

⇒ Work by C in L min = L × 7 ÷ 480

⇒ L × 7 ÷ 480 = 83 ÷ 120

⇒ L × 7 = (83 ÷ 120) × 480

⇒ L × 7 = 83 × 4 = 332

⇒ L = 332 ÷ 7

⇒ L ≈ 47.43 minutes

**∴ The correct answer is 332 ÷ 7 minutes.**
